_doc: LOCAL autonomous hunter driven by CLEO (the Hermes agent on the muse-infinite VPS, exposed as an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint). Hierarchical: Cleo emits one strategic INTENT every ~8s; the proven rule executor (scripts/agent/agent_brain.mjs) flies the hunter at 20Hz on YOUR local server. SETUP: npm run db:up && npm run server, then CLEO_BASE_URL=... CLEO_MODEL=... CLEO_API_KEY=... scripts/hunter_agents.sh cleo . MANUAL LAUNCH: CLHUNTER_PASS=... AGENT_PROVIDER=openai AGENT_PLAN=1 AGENT_BASE_URL=<cleo>/v1 AGENT_MODEL=<her model> AGENT_API_KEY=<token> AGENT_RESPONSE_FORMAT=0 node scripts/multibox.mjs scripts/multibox.hunter.cleo.json . Set AGENT_RESPONSE_FORMAT=0 if her server rejects response_format:json_object (the planner brace-extracts JSON from plain text too).
